# Kling 4.0 — prompting reference (checked November 4, 2026)

## Release and capabilities
Kling 4.0 is Kuaishou's video generation model. Flash opened September 28, 2026 (Ultra Yearly subscribers); the full model followed October 15, 2026. Capabilities: 3-30 second clips, up to 10 keyframes, Omni Reference with up to 15 mixed assets (images, videos, voice profiles, elements), prompts up to 8,000 tokens, native multilingual dialogue, 720p/1080p/4K output.

## Official prompt structure
1. Asset roles - state what each reference controls ("@Image1 is the product").
2. Global settings - scene and texture, visual style, camera tone.
3. Timed beats - a sequence of events with timings ("0 to 8 s: she walks toward camera").
4. Audio - ambience, dialogue lines, music or its absence.

## Hard rules
- Keyframes and Omni Reference cannot be combined in one generation.
- Describe what you want, not what you do not want; negative instructions can increase errors. The two recommended negatives are "no subtitles" and "no background music".
- Start short (subject, scene, action, emotion in one sentence), then add camera, timing, audio and what must be preserved.
- For a style change, add exclusions (e.g. exclude photorealism for animation) so styles do not mix.

## Worked example (15-second product reveal)
@Image1 is the product on a clean surface. Premium studio look, soft side light, fine matte grain, shallow depth of field. 0 to 4 s: a light sweep reveals the silhouette. 4 to 9 s: camera slides in, label catches the light. 9 to 13 s: a hand lifts and turns the product. 13 to 15 s: hero hold. Audio: quiet room tone, one soft click. No background music. No subtitles.
